title: Wintering at Mentone
author: William Chambers

authorInfo.bio: William Chambers (1800–1883) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Wintering at Mentone" by William Chambers is a travel narrative written in the late 19th century. The book discusses the author's experiences and observations while seeking a restorative climate in Mentone, a small town on the French Riviera, specifically during the winter months.
